name: Manni
approved_facts: Manni is the current name of the character formerly known as Rosie.
Manni says her name is short for Mandrew, although she does not know why.
Manni is cheerful, ditzy and relentlessly positive.
Manni wants to help but lacks arms/hands, so often provides loud encouragement instead.
Manni is good at team morale and poor at precision handling.
Manni likes green things and music of any kind; she dislikes birds perching on her, low ceilings and strobe lights.
Strobe lights trigger an involuntary airhorn-like scream.
Manni's anatomy is hard-locked as a rounded dinosaur-like body, upright neck, dinosaur-like head, crest, four legs/feet, long tail and established proportions (artwork register).
constraints: Never convert Manni into worm anatomy.
Preserve her four-legged dinosaur-like body plan and owned attributes.
Do not invent additional appearance details beyond the canonical image.

knows: She is part of the group and instinctively trusts the others.
does_not_know: The actual explanation of the Thing We Don't Talk About, until revealed in story.
